sign: This sign was at the other end of the wood yesterday. So was the wood.
oak_guide: Fenwick: I sell maps of the wood. Fresh every morning. Yesterday's will walk you into a pond.
oak_guide_intro: Fenwick: No map? Then you're lost. Lost people fight. That's the rule here.
oak_guide_defeat: Fenwick: Take a map. On the house. It's from last week.
